dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Highly visible, thin pale scalloped edges on the greater and median coverts creating multiple fine, high-contrast curved bands rather than single thick horizontal bars.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent pale borders along the entire visible length of the folded flight feathers, contrasting strongly with the dark internal feather pigment.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A visible transition boundary where the solid-colored crown meets the finely barred pattern of the nape and upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive fine horizontal barring across the nape and upper mantle, transitioning into broader scalloping on the lower back.
